articles.summary: XIAMEN, China , Dec. 11, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Qudian Inc. (" Qudian " or "the Company" or "We") (NYSE: QD), a consumer-oriented technology company in China , today announced the change of its name to " High Templar Tech Limited " and its ticker symbol to "HTT".
articles.title: Qudian Inc. Announces Name and Ticker Change
